scope: Exploratory expansion after observing the original four-MACE pilot; not a new independent test
data: same frozen 128 meta-development reactions and 60 selection-validation reactions; prospective holdout labels remain unopened
comparison: same fixed geometries and each model's reactant-relative energies; target DFT differences retained, no raw-energy mixing

aimnet2-wb97m.precision: native mixed precision, no forced conversion
aimnet2-wb97m.license: MIT code; pretrained model provenance retained from official registry
aimnet2-wb97m.training_overlap: unverified; do not claim foundation-unseen generalization

aimnet2-rxn.reference_method: official aimnet 0.2.6 rxn calculator, includes its prescribed D3 correction; canonical HF card and documentation differ in method wording
aimnet2-rxn.training_data: AIMNet2 base set plus RGD-1, about 4.7 million geometries, per canonical model card
aimnet2-rxn.precision: native mixed precision, no forced conversion
aimnet2-rxn.license: MIT code; pretrained model provenance retained from official registry
aimnet2-rxn.training_overlap: reaction-level overlap with Transition1x not established; cannot label this foundation-unseen

ani2x.reference_method: wB97X/6-31G(d), same named level as Transition1x
ani2x.training_overlap: unverified; intended as a distinct descriptor-network baseline, not guaranteed reactive accuracy

orbmol-conservative.training_overlap: unverified; molecular pretraining is not evidence of unseen reaction identities
orbmol-conservative.forces: conservative gradient model; direct-force variant excluded
